calls.title: Pro Pricing Discussion
calls.summary:
# Pro Pricing Discussion
Date: 2026-11-10 | Duration: 39m

## Summary
The discussion favored making Pro managed-warehouse-only, potentially moving bring-your-own warehouse and customer-managed event forwarders to Enterprise, while considering additional feature flagging in the free or lower funnel to attract users. Current Pro pricing was benchmarked at $40 per seat, 2,000 included monthly events, and $40 per million events, with modeled revenue near $3.2 million. Scenarios targeting $6 million, $9 million, and $12 million were evaluated, with $9 million viewed as more balanced. A Statsig-like model of $150 per account monthly, 5 million included events, and $50 per additional million was requested. Small feature-flagging customers could downgrade, while experiment-large customers generated nearly all modeled upside but might resist managed warehouses and per-event pricing. A move from about $960 to $5,000 monthly could cause churn, while approximately $3,000 was considered more acceptable. Follow-up work includes account- and segment-level modeling, retention assumptions, warehouse adoption, revenue totals, and possible concurrency pricing.

## Keywords
Managed warehouse, Event-based pricing, Statsig pricing, Feature flags, Experiment pricing, Revenue modelling

## Action Items

Build pricing model (08:39)
Break projected revenue down by account and segment (23:31)
Add total revenue calculation (24:13)

**Jeremy Dorn**
Share pricing analysis and materials (28:46)
